author: Bikeshid
title: Worst customer service
review_text: Very disappointing customer support experience. I have tried contacting the support team through both their live chat and Instagram, but it has been more than a month and I still haven’t received any response.   Being ignored for such a long time is frustrating, especially when you need assistance. Customer service should be more responsive and reliable. Unfortunately, based on my experience, I cannot recommend their support.
